title: Window mode also changes screen under certain conditions
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 4.6.3

### System information

Godot v4.6.3.stable - Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS 24.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon 760M Graphics (radeonsi, phoenix, LLVM 20.1.2, DRM 3.57, 6.8.0-142-generic) - AMD Ryzen 5 7640U w/ Radeon 760M Graphics (12 threads) - 13.45 GiB memory

### Issue description

I observed that `WindowMode` changes the screen under certain conditions:
- Editor: If the project is on the same screen as the editor, changing `WindowMode` to `Windowed` or `Maximized` triggers it.
- Exported project: If the project is on the primary screen, changing `WindowMode` to `Windowed` or `Maximized` triggers it.

Maybe it also has to start in one of the fullscreen modes but I am unsure as of now.

I am setting it via `get_tree().root.mode = item_id` where `item_id` is the ID of an `OptionButton` item.
(The items have IDs corresponding to `Window.Mode`.)
Same problem if I set it via `get_window().mode = item_id`.
Also doesn't matter if I use `Window.MODE_WINDOWED` or `Window.Mode.MODE_WINDOWED`.

### Steps to reproduce

- Run MRP, move window to primary screen (doesn't have to be from within the project, via OS is fine, too)
- change window mode to windowed or maximized

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Upload is failing... :(

So I guess we're gonna have to do it like this:
- root: `Node`
- children: `Button` (x5)

```gdscript
extends Node

@export var use_root: bool = true

@onready var windowed_button: Button = $WindowedButton
@onready var minimized_button: Button = $MinimizedButton
@onready var maximized_button: Button = $MaximizedButton
@onready var fullscreen_button: Button = $FullscreenButton
@onready var exclusive_fullscreen_button: Button = $ExclusiveFullscreenButton

func _ready() -> void:
	windowed_button.pressed.connect(_set_window_mode.bind(Window.Mode.MODE_WINDOWED))
	minimized_button.pressed.connect(_set_window_mode.bind(Window.Mode.MODE_MINIMIZED))
	maximized_button.pressed.connect(_set_window_mode.bind(Window.Mode.MODE_MAXIMIZED))
	fullscreen_button.pressed.connect(_set_window_mode.bind(Window.Mode.MODE_FULLSCREEN))
	exclusive_fullscreen_button.pressed.connect(_set_window_mode.bind(Window.Mode.MODE_EXCLUSIVE_FULLSCREEN))

func _set_window_mode(mode: Window.Mode) -> void:
	if use_root:
		get_tree().root.mode = mode
	else:
		get_window().mode = mode

```

---

Update: Something seems to screw with the current screen, as well. Sometimes after maximizing, I cannot change the current screen any more.
